name: production
note: Two tenants, as on a DevNet cluster serving two validators: each its own driver certificate and key prefixes, and three key classes. Signing class (DKG, practically all traffic): the ladder and the disruption load, the measured shape of a DevNet validator over 7 days times the factor, per tenant. Namespace class: a handful of signatures a month on that cluster, so here one during each disruption, one during the upgrade and one at rest, each within the driver's deadlines, and a rate limit of 10 a minute and 200 a day whose excess must be refused. Hosted class (encryption key): 9 operations in 30 days there, so the same spot checks with one decryption each. Needs k8s-deploy.sh's production values (the cluster suite's default install).
